entries.title: A message waiting for a crewmate says why it waits
entries.body: When a crewmate cannot take a message yet, your first mate now tells you the real reason: a spending limit, its computer out of reach, an update, a move to another computer, or its account. For a spending limit it points you to the card whose answer lets the work go on, instead of saying the account is not answering.
entries.noPicture: This changes what the first mate is told and says in its answer, not a view or control.
